name: subagent-terminal-closes-open-chunk-stream
description: a subagent's terminal closes the chunk stream still open in its own lane, so the run completes cleanly with the delegated message assembled
kill: make SUBAGENT_FINISHED pass through without closing its lane, so the message stays open past its owner's end

dotnet.intentional: GAP, not a design difference: EventStreamConverter has no case for TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK or TOOL_CALL_CHUNK, so a chunk stream falls through to the pass-through branch. Nothing is expanded into a message and none of the chunk-stream rules are enforced. Pinned here so the gap cannot widen or close unnoticed; alignment tracked separately. No chunk stream is opened, so no subagent terminal closes one and no message is assembled.
